Hero.title: We build
Hero.description: We support migrants in the Basque Country, promoting inclusion, independence and intercultural coexistence based on solidarity.
Hero.mission: A community where everyone has opportunities to grow.

values.title: People, community and opportunities
values.description: We work alongside people and the community to build a more open and inclusive society.

accompaniment.title: Support
accompaniment.description: Social and cultural guidance and information to support integration and independence.

community.title: Community
community.description: We create support networks and spaces to share, participate and feel part of the community.

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: Workshops, cultural gatherings and activities open to everyone in the community.

about.title: Building bridges towards an inclusive society
about.description: We are a non-profit association founded in Vitoria-Gasteiz with the aim of breaking down barriers and promoting intercultural coexistence.
about.description2: We believe in the power of community to transform lives by providing tools, support and opportunities to people who are beginning a new journey in the Basque Country.

projects.title: Projects that create impact
projects.description: Initiatives designed to strengthen independence, participation and coexistence.

news.title: Latest news
news.description: Discover our latest activities and updates.

communityCta.description: An inclusive society is built by everyone. Discover our work, collaborate with us or get in touch.
